    Input text is preserved. No automatic corrections.
    
    
    Three clear outputs. Clean rows, a separate exception list, and a complete traceable JSON report.
    
    
    01 / A count you can reconcile
    Every row is clean, review, or invalid — never more than one. The valid net includes clean and review rows. Invalid rows are excluded, never treated as zero.
    02 / A flag is not a deletion
    Possible duplicates share a date, trimmed case-sensitive description and amount. Every candidate stays in the report; review rows are held out of the clean export.
    03 / Your original stays yours
    Processing uses only this tab’s memory. CSV text is protected against formula injection; exact original fields remain in JSON. No storage, server, AI or accounting judgment.
    
    
    ROWPROOF / AN ORIGINAL DEMONSTRATION
